sentence_en: Artificial reefs are built for the enjoyment of divers and to protect the environment and historically sensitive maritime habitats.
sentence_zh: 人工鱼礁既供潜水者游玩，也用来保护环境和具有历史意义的脆弱海洋栖息地。

sentence_en: Global overpopulation may not be an issue if fertility rates around the world continue to fall.
sentence_zh: 如果全球生育率持续下降，人口过剩可能就不成问题了。

meaning_zh: 施肥，使肥沃；使受精（英式拼写 fertilise）
sentence_en: The use of pesticides for fertilizing crops is quite controversial.
sentence_zh: 给农作物施肥时使用农药颇具争议。

sentence_en: I heard that the Great Wall of China is a spectacular sight to see.
sentence_zh: 我听说中国的长城是一道壮观的景色。

sentence_en: Chinese New Year is celebrated at a different time every year depending on the lunar calendar.
sentence_zh: 春节按农历计算，所以每年庆祝的时间都不同。

sentence_en: Zero degrees Celsius is the temperature that water freezes at.
sentence_zh: 零摄氏度是水结冰的温度。

sentence_en: Her temperature was 99 degrees Fahrenheit, which is above normal but still not considered to be a fever.
sentence_zh: 她的体温是华氏99度，高于正常但还不算发烧。

sentence_en: Many people at the beach are content to just stare into the horizon, where the ocean meets the sky.
sentence_zh: 海滩上很多人只是满足地凝望着海天相接的地平线。

sentence_en: The place where I live actually has many landmarks, and one of them is the art palace.
sentence_zh: 我住的地方其实有很多地标，艺术宫就是其中之一。

sentence_en: The terrestrial animals can be found in the north, east and central parts of the zoo.
sentence_zh: 陆栖动物在动物园的北部、东部和中部。

sentence_en: At the aquarium you can see many different kinds of marine life.
sentence_zh: 在水族馆里你可以看到许多不同种类的海洋生物。

sentence_en: The water shortage in our town meant that only once in every three days could a household have access to water.
sentence_zh: 我们镇缺水，每户人家每三天才能用一次水。

sentence_en: In very dry climates such as that of central Queensland, water irrigation is necessary to grow crops.
sentence_zh: 在昆士兰中部这样非常干燥的气候下，种庄稼必须灌溉。

sentence_en: Droughts have a devastating effect on farmers who depend on a regular supply of rain to water their crops.
sentence_zh: 干旱对靠定期降雨浇灌庄稼的农民影响极大。

sentence_en: Most species of penguins live in Antarctica.
sentence_zh: 大多数种类的企鹅生活在南极洲。

meaning_zh: 南北极地的；完全相反的
sentence_en: Because of global warming, the polar ice caps are slowly melting.
sentence_zh: 由于全球变暖，极地冰盖正在慢慢融化。

sentence_en: Many scientists agree that carbon dioxide is a major cause of global warming.
sentence_zh: 许多科学家认为二氧化碳是全球变暖的主要原因。

sentence_en: This lotion is a good product because not only does it make your skin softer, but it also protects your skin from ultraviolet rays.
sentence_zh: 这款乳液很好，它不仅让皮肤更柔软，还能保护皮肤免受紫外线伤害。

sentence_en: There are many fascinating sea creatures that can be found in the Great Barrier Reef which runs along the eastern coast of Australia.
sentence_zh: 沿澳大利亚东海岸延伸的大堡礁里有许多迷人的海洋生物。

sentence_en: The moisture in the air is making the car windows foggy.
sentence_zh: 空气中的湿气让车窗起雾了。

sentence_en: During the monsoon season, it is best to keep an umbrella with you.
sentence_zh: 雨季期间最好随身带把伞。

sentence_en: Designer babies have been genetically engineered to make up for nature's flaws.
sentence_zh: “设计婴儿”经过基因改造，以弥补自然的缺陷。

sentence_en: Cotton is much better at absorbing liquids than nylon.
sentence_zh: 棉花吸收液体的能力比尼龙强得多。

meaning_zh: 爆发（派生：erupt v. 爆发）
sentence_en: That volcano has been dormant for over one hundred years, so there is little chance of an eruption.
sentence_zh: 那座火山已经休眠一百多年了，所以喷发的可能性很小。
